# Pattaya Rent a Bike
> pattayarentabike.com

Trusted motorbike and scooter rental in Pattaya since 2010. Yamaha and Honda fleet, full insurance, 10,000+ happy customers.

## Contact
- Phone/WhatsApp: +66 83 077 6928
- Email: info@pattayarentacar.com
- Line: @pattayarentacar

## Office
- Central Pattaya Office, 359/119 Moo 12 Nongprue, Pattaya City, Chon Buri 20150
- Open 9am - 5pm, 365 days a year
- Pickup and return at this office only — no hotel delivery

## Fleet & Pricing (per day / per month, THB)
- Yamaha GT 125 (125cc, Auto): 200/day, 2,500/month
- Yamaha Nmax (155cc, Auto): 300/day, 4,000/month
- Honda PCX (150cc, Auto): 300/day, 4,000/month
- Yamaha Aerox (155cc, Auto): 300/day, 4,000/month

Prices are subject to change at short notice — confirm exact price and availability at time of booking.

## Rental Requirements
- Original passport and a valid driving license required
- 1,000 THB cash deposit required
- Compulsory government insurance (Po Lo Bo) included on all bikes
